submission_override: Job 249542 initially requested interactive/10 CPUs/96GB. After a several-hour estimated wait, the same pending job was updated to hpc-mid/4 CPUs/32GB. It started on slurm-h200-238-029 before a subsequent request to shorten its time limit and normalize residual minimum-CPU fields; that subsequent update was rejected because it was running. Actual scheduler state is preserved in merge-checked-slurm-state.txt. Final accounting reports 8 allocated CPUs and 5,529,640 KiB peak host RSS; four was the revised task CPU request.
limits: Suites overlap; counts are not a sum of unique coverage.
Per-residue aggregate checks occur after sampler-specific source arrays exist, before merged rows and coordinates. They do not cap total-task or pair-energy memory.
Default sampler policy is unchanged without explicit task limits. Required unions raise instead of dropping states; adaptive source-library expansion remains separate.
Performance compares only the shared merge against the exact preceding function, not complete sampling, chemistry, scoring or packing. Inputs and parity verification are outside timing.
Final benchmarks include count-range and ordered-row validation. Tiny inputs have no meaningful performance gain.
CUDA peak memory counts allocated tensor storage above held inputs; it excludes reserved allocator memory and process RSS. CPU memory is not measured.
